job.title: E-commerce Solutions Lead
job.location: Praha - východ, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and web platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, data modeling and database optimization, with proven delivery of integrations between PIM, ERP and enterprise systems. Experienced in requirements analysis, user stories, stakeholder management and AI-assisted delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: E-commerce Solutions Lead
cover_en.hook: UNIQA's commitment to delivering award-winning digital solutions and diverse enterprise platforms makes this E-commerce Solutions Lead role an inspiring opportunity. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on technical and functional experience building large-scale e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to your digital roadmap across the Czech and Slovak markets.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Delivery
bullets.text: Operated in a techno-functional capacity bridging business stakeholders and technical teams, translating business requirements and user stories into robust SAP Commerce platform solutions.

bullets.label: Platform & API Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on enterprise platforms using Java and Spring, exposing headless OCC REST APIs and optimizing product catalog data flows.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Coordination
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international technical teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to prioritize backlogs, streamline API migrations, and drive delivery stability.

bullets.label: Process Automation & AI
bullets.text: Leveraged AI tools extensively to accelerate analysis, development, testing, and documentation while maintaining high performance, data consistency, and system reliability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise platform experience aligns with UNIQA's goals.

tailoring.why_company: UNIQA CZ stands out for its award-winning digital insurance and financial solutions across the Czech and Slovak markets, driven by a strong commitment to diversity and innovation. My 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell align directly with UNIQA's ambition to lead in digital platform delivery, user experience, and backend stability.
tailoring.motivation_short: To drive scalable e-commerce solutions and enterprise platform growth at UNIQA, leveraging my 5+ years of experience in backend development, integration, and techno-functional delivery.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional experience building large platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in the E-commerce Solutions Lead role at UNIQA CZ. My CV and cover letter are attached. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for E-commerce Solutions Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the E-commerce Solutions Lead position at UNIQA CZ. With over 5 years of professional experience building and scaling large enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend architecture, API integrations, and techno-functional delivery.

My tailored CV and cover letter are attached to this email. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your digital roadmap.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
